blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `updateTaxRatesStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.
This step updates tax rates matching the specified filters.

children.name: UpdateTaxRatesStepInput
children.description: The data to update tax rates.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the tax rate.

children.name: code
children.description: The code the tax rate is identified by.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the Tax Rate.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: tax_region_id
children.description: The ID of the associated tax region.

children.name: is_combinable
children.description:
Whether the tax rate should be combined with parent rates.

Learn more [here](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/tax/tax-rates-and-rules#combinable-tax-rates).

children.name: is_default
children.description: Whether the tax rate is the default rate for the region.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The creation date of the tax rate.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The update date of the tax rate.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The deletion date of the tax rate.

children.name: created_by
children.description: Who created the tax rate. For example, the ID of the user that created the tax rate.
